tools.name: lookup_postcode
tools.description: Everything about one UK postcode, or up to 50 at once: whether it is live or terminated, latitude and longitude, and the council, ward, parish, constituency, county, region, police force, NHS board, rural-urban class and deprivation decile it sits in. Use for any question about where a postcode is o

tools.name: validate_postcode
tools.description: Checks a UK postcode: is the format right, is it in the current official data, and is it still in use. Northern Ireland (BT) postcodes are checked by format only.

tools.name: nearest_postcodes
tools.description: Live UK postcodes nearest a postcode or a latitude/longitude, closest first, with distances in metres. Use it to find the postcode for coordinates (reverse geocoding) or what is near an address.

tools.name: postcode_distance
tools.description: Straight-line distance between two UK postcodes in kilometres and miles, with the compass direction.

tools.name: area_info
tools.description: Facts about a postcode area (e.g. "SW"), district ("SW1A") or sector ("SW1A 1"): how many postcodes, the councils, wards and constituencies it covers, its centre and places in it.

tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Finds UK cities, towns, villages and neighbourhoods by name and returns each one's postcode district, council and coordinates (OS Open Names).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search UK postcodes, districts and places. Returns ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full record for an id returned by search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
